fonts.__note: NOT A GUESS: the sandbox src/index.css @imports @fontsource-variable/inter and the vega preset's @theme declares --font-sans: 'Inter Variable', sans-serif — the library's OWN declared face. The webfont ships on npm (RECON §1), so the face inlines as a data: URI from the sandboxed package; the built tailwind.css's own @font-face src URLs are relative paths that cannot resolve from the harness page, which is exactly why this substrate exists.
